svg.title: Mask R-CNN R50 segmentation
svg.desc: 800 × 800 RGB canvas; batch 1; eval. COCO: 91 internal slots mapped to 80 classes. R and N are data-dependent counts.

g.data-description: Bilinear resize. Min edge 800; max edge 1333

The stride is in the bottleneck 3×3 convolution.
RPN receives 5 feature maps. RoIAlign excludes the extra pooled map.
FPN normalization: BatchNorm2d, eps=0.00001; no activation.

g.data-description: Each FPN feature independently. 256 channels; shared RPN weights
Conv2d 3×3 + ReLU. 256 channels; repeat 2; no norm
Top-K per level, then sigmoid. 1000 pre-NMS proposals per level
Flatten anchor rows. Weights for box delta decode: 1,1,1,1
Generate anchors. 3 per location; one size per level

g.text: R × 4 boxes; R varies with image values
Raw anchor rows on this canvas: 159,882.
Clip to canvas; remove boxes smaller than 0.001 pixels.
Box RoI head and final detection selection

g.data-description: Softmax across 91 slots. Drop background slot 0

The mask branch reuses FPN features and the final boxes from the box head. It does not rerun the backbone.
91 mask channels are architectural slots; each detection selects its predicted class channel before pasting.

ReLU or Hardswish. Hardswish(x) = x × clamp(x + 3, 0, 6) / 6
